Located in the heart of the city, our hotel offers the perfect base for your cultural adventure in Hanoi. Wake up in the best neighborhood, just 640m away from the Old Quarter and experience the true essence of Hanoi. At San Serenata Hotel, we understand that discerning travelers like you deserve nothing but the best. That’s why we provide an array of amenities that cater to your every need. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi, and if you need a ride to or from the airport, our hotel can arrange a car for you before your check-in date. We provide taxi services, car rentals, and shuttle services to help you get to your desired locations in Hanoi. For those arriving by car, free parking is available, and our front desk services including a safe, express check-in or check-out, luggage storage, and customer care service ensure that you have no problems planning your days and transportation needs. Our tour and ticket services will help you secure the best entertainment seats in the city, and even chilly nights are better when you can warm up by the hotel’s cozy fireplace. Staying for a long time or just need clean clothes? No problem, our hotel’s dry cleaning and laundry services will keep your favorite travel outfits clean and ready. Forgot to pack something? Our convenience store has got you covered. Our guest rooms offer even more amenities for your comfort and convenience. Some selected rooms feature blackout curtains, laundry services, and air conditioning. You can also choose a room with a balcony or terrace to enjoy the stunning views of Hanoi. Each room comes equipped with a coffee/tea maker, bottled water, instant coffee, and a small refrigerator stocked with drinks. You can also enjoy luxurious bath towels, bathrobes, hairdryers, and toiletries in some of the guest bathrooms. Start your day off right with a delicious breakfast on site, and enjoy a cup of coffee at our coffee shop. During your stay, choose from a variety of delicious dining options at our hotel. You can even have a memorable evening with your companions at our hotel bar or order food to your room with our convenient delivery service. We offer unique entertainment opportunities for all our guests, including access to a fitness center, a golf course, and a hiking trail. You can also relax in our common waiting room and TV area or shop for souvenirs at our gift shop and souvenir store.
